question: Does a committed UsdPreviewSurface fixture for emission extract through Hydra, Hio's decoded HDR texels included, to its independent C++ mirror and render, headless and through Hydra, in agreement with committed Reference PT images under BSDF sampling and NEE/MIS; and which emission behaviours need a fix?

procedure.fixture: python scripts/material_fixtures.py write; usdchecker validation/materials/material-emission-v1.usda (fails only on the unresolvable ./textures/missing.png, authored on purpose)
procedure.reference: lotus-headless --write-material-reference validation/reference: every fixture in a cleared GPU scene, BSDF sampling, reference integrator, 64 batches of 64 samples then 4096 samples from sample index 0; material-emission-v1 at 160x160
procedure.headless_check: cmake --build build/cy2026-windows-x86_64-py313-core --target lotus-headless (its post-build report, renderer.material.fixtures), then ctest -R 'lotus-validation-assets|lotus-renderer-evidence|lotus-renderer-install-tree|lotus-test-tiers'
procedure.scripts: python -m unittest test_material_fixtures; python scripts/material_fixtures.py check; python scripts/check_docs.py

warnings: Lotus cannot read the texture ./textures/missing.png of /MaterialEmission/Looks/Missing: it cannot be opened as an image
Lotus ignores the GeomSubset material bindings of /MaterialEmission/Objects/Subset: the mesh's own binding covers every face

byte_identical: headless wavefront-mis and reference-mis images at 16 and 256 spp
Hydra and the backend's image of the mirror, NEE/MIS and BSDF, 256 spp

negative_control.change: textures/palette.png|sRGB decoded as Rgba8Unorm (Srgb, TexturedSphere, Shared and Unlit)

reference_pixels.method: mean of the committed reference over a block at each object's projected centre: 8x8 pixels for Warm, Back, Mirrored, Stretched and NonFinite, 4x4 for Tilted, 6x6 for the others

audit.constant_emission: as documented; non-negative clamp, no upper clamp
audit.emission_and_bsdf: as documented; emission beside the full BSDF
audit.two_sided_emission: as documented; a card seen from behind shows the same emission
audit.transforms_and_angle: as documented; mirrored, stretched and tilted emitters show the same emission, and NEE/MIS agrees with the reference
audit.hdr_maps: as documented; Rgba32Float, linear under raw and auto, CPU-decoded under sRGB, texels exact
audit.float_map_light_estimate: documented now: the [0, 1] bound underestimates float texels above 1, which costs variance only
audit.unlit_assets: as documented; diffuseColor 0 with ior 1 reflects nothing
audit.geom_subset_bindings: fixed: silently ignored before; the adapter now warns, and per-face materials remain unsupported
fixes: adapters/hydra2/src/adapter.cpp warns when a mesh's topology carries GeomSubset material bindings

not_run: viewport, usdview and the installed Hydra host with the fixture
Hydra CTests other than the two material-fixture CTests
light-table entries and weights (only their images were compared)
